scientific.integrity: The infinite statement is proved using Hall's theorem. Exhaustive computation through order 10 is corroborative only and is not presented as an infinite certificate.
scientific.limitations: The all-set theorem is self-contained, but the 2016 paired-domination-polynomial source was available only as a one-page abstract and the 2020 chain-graph upper-paired-domination source only through abstract/bibliographic records; a residual historical-indexing risk therefore remains.
